hero-bullet: Priority immigration lane — past the 60–90 minute winter-charter queue
peak-body: Cam Ranh is a small terminal serving big aircraft, and since 12 October Chinese group tours have been visa-free here — but only flying direct from mainland China into Cam Ranh, in and out through the same airport. Add the winter charters and the T2 hall fills — 60 to 90 minutes at peak.
faq-night: Russian charters and Korean services put much of Cam Ranh's traffic in these hours — Khanh Hoa took 685,000 international visitors in October alone. We operate 24/7 regardless of flight time.
